text:
emma_csm: Heads-up on TidalCare renewal. Procurement emailed a PO with vendor_code TIDAL-OPS-21 (not in our registry). They want Net60, split invoices US/EU, add 25 seats, keep unit price and move to 12mo. Also asked if PO must be attached to DocuSign envelope. Any immediate flags?

cal_ae: On a call with procurement now  they prefer Net60 for internal audit. PO will be attached to the envelope. They said split payments are likely but will try to nominate a single payor.

ravi_fin: Net60 ok if we get tax IDs and correct billing legal names. Split invoices add operational work; need confirmation which legal entity accepts liability. If payor remains split, Finance may request partial prepayment or credit approval.

sara_legal: Amendment preferred for seat + term change. DocuSign fine; wet-sign will add 3-5 business days. Confirm VAT treatment for EU split and check whether the vendor_code maps to a legal billing entity.

liz_enable: If seats added, enablement can provide a regional kickoff + 6hrs. Holding a tentative slot week after EDD, will release if not confirmed by EOD Fri.

emma_csm: Procurement excerpt: "VendorCode: TIDAL-OPS-21; PO# 991122; invoice 75% Tidal US (ap@tidal.us) / 25% Tidal EU (ap-eu@tidal.eu); prefer Net60; will sign via DocuSign."

cal_ae: Asked for US EIN and EU VAT on the call. Pushed for single payor and asked whether prepay (3% for 6mo) is acceptable. Procurement to confirm.

ravi_fin: Please gather: 1) US EIN, 2) EU VAT, 3) liability payor, 4) invoice currency for EU portion. Without these, Finance won't approve Net60 for split invoices.

sara_legal: I'll review the DocuSign amendment once AE attaches PO and entity names. If customer requests DPA or indemnity tweaks for EU, escalate.

emma_csm: Marking "vendor_code mismatch" as high risk and "Net60 + split invoices" medium risk. AE please ping here once tax IDs are in so we can target DocuSign send within 48h.

signbot: Draft amendment ready (internal): https://docusign.example/envelope/tidal-555  fields: attach PO, billing selectors, signer roles.

emma_csm: Thanks all ":thumbsup:" will update renewal tracker and follow up after AE call.
